title: Regulated stock register
description: A legal register for regulated stock (controlled medicine, liquor, tobacco, duty-free), its books declared per market as data and kept by the POS app's register door: one line for each sale or receipt of a regulated item, written in the same save, numbered without a gap, never edited, with a running balance where the law keeps one. It installs each market's books, their prints, a reminder before each return, the register's lists and open-tasks cards, the register's own columns on the Desk sale and delivery and the till's sale details, and the approver role. It reads the pharmacy counter app's drug schedules, prescriptions and patients: install that app first.

data.text: Open tasks: search Desk for the dashboard PP RSR Register, whose cards count the entries entered late, incomplete or below zero, the counts due after a loss and the periods not yet signed off (a return is sent for each); each card opens its list. The saved lists: PP RSR Register entries, PP RSR Losses and disposals, PP RSR Counts due after a loss and PP RSR Periods open (search Desk for each; filter a list by book, store and dates). The books are on Retail Register Book: switch on your market's books, map their register stores before the first sale, and count each item's opening balance before its first receipt or sale. At each sale of a book that asks for it, print the purchaser's slip from the sale for the purchaser to sign. Each day at close, print the day's pages of each book (Print book on the book, today's dates) and keep them at the store, for an outage. Once a book's retention has passed, Erase persons' details on the book erases a person's details from the entries then due and says what still waits; it has no preview.
